hoaxes.title: Anthropic IPO buyers get a free year of Claude Pro with every 100 shares
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share and starts trading on Nasdaq as ANT today.

hoaxes.title: Avengers: Doomsday tickets come with a Doctor Doom mask that unlocks a bonus scene
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Marvel released 11 character posters and a featurette; the film opens December 18.

hoaxes.title: GTA VI ships with an 'office mode' that disguises the game as a spreadsheet
hoaxes.truth: Made up. GTA VI launched with a 99 on Metacritic, and a survey says 18% of salaried workers planned the day off.

hoaxes.title: Apple's HomeView will double as a kitchen scale in a software update
hoaxes.truth: Made up. HomeView is a $299 smart display with a 7-inch square screen that launched on November 13.
